_about: Rival bot clan (src/sim/bot.js, docs/rival_bot_plan.md). difficulty picks a level (Tim 2026-10-19: easy for now). Any knob left out of a level uses BOT_DEFAULTS in bot.js. thinkSeconds: how often it picks a goal; reactSeconds: how often it handles fights; reserve: ryo kept back when hiring; escort: crew kept following the boss (the rest are stationed, one per business: stationPerBusiness); patrolChance: chance it walks to one of its places when idle; attackChance / attackMinCrew / attackMaxHeat: night attacks on unclaimed businesses; huntBandits / huntRange: hunt public camps and visible bandits for ryo; bribeAtHeat: bribe the police from this heat; raidChance / raidMinCrew / raidReserve: War Lantern raids (scouts the target first); raidWhenWeak: avoid a visible boss defending the target; memorySeconds: how long scouted info counts; ambush / ambushRange: jump lone rival crew near its own places; heroPriority: crew go for the rival boss first; focusFire: all crew hit the weakest enemy; executeDowned: finish off downed rival crew when safe; retreatHp: send crew below this share of HP to the clinic (0 = never); abilities: which of its boss's Q E R F it uses.
_yakuza: Shinobi, Yakuza and Kuroda: the two clans you do not play are bots. Yakuza and Kuroda share the rival brain and difficulty levels.
_adaptive: Phase 3 (2026-10-21): both brains use public camps and visible threats. riskRatio is the enemy/own combat-strength limit for starting optional fights (lower = more cautious); huntRetreatHp is the boss HP share to end a hunt and recover; restUntilHp is the recovery target at HQ; goalCooldownSeconds delays retrying failed destinations. Difficulty changes decisions and response time, never starting money, income or damage. Shinobi jobSeconds is its active-job time budget, plus legitimate waiting for night on mark jobs. jobs is a preference within reward/time/risk scoring.
_shinobi: Playing Yakuza, the Shinobi bot clan (src/sim/ninja_bot.js) lives in the village longhouse: hires ninja at the dojo, takes contracts at the shrine (jobs = preference order within reward/time/risk scoring), sneaks in by back windows, hunts bosses and bandits; shinobiLevels knobs per difficulty (any left out use NINJA_BOT_DEFAULTS).
